svg.title: Public demo — open access with read-only queries
svg.desc: Anyone can try the demonstration without logging in. The app validates a single SELECT-based query and rejects writes, deletes, and schema changes. Accepted queries run in a read-only PostgreSQL transaction and return up to 1,000 rows. Dataset seeding is separate from this query path.
